name: Mùa 5
mechanic: Trang bị Bóng Tối: phiên bản mạnh hơn kèm cái giá phải trả.

traits.name: Caretaker
traits.description: (@MinUnits@) Caretakers deploy with a Baby Dragon that can be placed anywhere on the battlefield. The Baby Dragon gains @AttackSpeed@% of its Caretaker's Attack Speed, and restores @ManaRefund@ Mana to the Caretaker upon death.

traits.name: Dragonslayer
traits.description:
Dragonslayers always gain bonus Ability Power.

After the first Dragonslayer ally scores a takedown on an enemy with at least @MaxHealthThreshold@ maximum Health, all allies gain additional Ability Power for the rest of combat.

(@MinUnits@) @DragonslayerAP@ Ability Power for Dragonslayers, @TeamAP@ for team

traits.name: Spellweaver
traits.description:
Spellweavers have bonus Ability Power, which increases whenever any champion uses an ability (up to @StackCap@ times).

(@MinUnits@) @AP@ Ability Power, @BonusAP@ bonus Ability Power

traits.name: Legionnaire
traits.description:
Legionnaires gain bonus Attack Speed, and their first attack after casting an Ability heals them for @HealPercent@% of the damage dealt.

(@MinUnits@) @ASBoostPercent@% Attack Speed

traits.name: Invoker
traits.description:
All allies gain extra Mana from their attacks.

(@MinUnits@) +@ManaPerAttack@ Mana

traits.name: Draconic
traits.description:
(@MinUnits@) At the end of each player combat, gain a dragon egg on your bench. The bigger the egg, the longer it takes to hatch, and the rarer the reward.
(@MinUnits@). Dragon eggs are golden! Golden eggs hatch into even rarer loot.

In Hyper Roll, dragon eggs hatch a lot faster!

traits.name: Hellion
traits.description:
Hellions gain Attack Speed.

Whenever a Hellion dies, a Doppelhellion (a one less star copy) will leap from the Hellion portal and join the fight!

(@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeedPercent@% Attack Speed.

traits.name: Ranger
traits.description:
Every @DelayBetweenBuffs@ seconds Rangers gain increased Attack Speed that lasts @BuffDuration@ seconds. This effect begins @InitialDelay@ seconds after combat starts.

(@MinUnits@) +@AttackSpeed@% Attack Speed

traits.name: Coven
traits.description:
(@MinUnits@) At the start of combat, the champion nearest to the center of your Coven champions is chosen as the Coven Leader, gaining @AbilityPower@ bonus Ability Power.

Each time a Coven champion casts, @PercentMana@% of the cost is bestowed upon the Coven Leader as Mana.

traits.name: Eternal
traits.description: (@MinUnits@) Wolf separates from Lamb, and can be placed anywhere on the battlefield. Wolf does not count toward your team size, and receives all of Lamb's stat bonuses.

traits.name: Verdant
traits.description:
Champions that start combat adjacent to at least one Verdant ally are immune to crowd control for a duration.

(@MinUnits@) @Duration@ seconds

traits.name: Abomination
traits.description:
When @AllyDeaths@ allied champions have died, the Monstrosity will rise from its grave. The Monstrosity receives bonus Health and Attack Damage based on allied Abomination champions' star levels.

The 3 Abomination champions nearest the grave will also grant the Monstrosity a random copy of one of their items when combat starts.

(@MinUnits@) @FlatHealth@ Health, @FlatAD@ Attack Damage

traits.name: Assassin
traits.description:
Innate: When combat starts, Assassins leap to the enemy backline.

Assassins' Abilities can critically strike and they gain bonus Critical Strike Chance and bonus Critical Strike Damage.

(@MinUnits@) +@CritChanceAmpPercent@% Crit Chance and +@CritAmpPercent@% Crit Damage

traits.name: Redeemed
traits.description:
Redeemed champions have increased Armor, Magic Resist, and Ability Power. When they die, their bonus is split among remaining Redeemed allies.

(@MinUnits@) @ArmorAmount@ Armor & Magic Resist, @AbilityPowerAmount@ Ability Power

traits.name: Cruel
traits.description:
(@MinUnits@) A Cruel champion hungers to be alone against exactly 1 enemy left standing.

Cruel champions are purchased with Little Legend Health instead of gold. They can be sold for gold, but not Health. You're welcome.

traits.name: Renewer
traits.description:
Renewers heal for a percent of their maximum Health each second. If they're full Health, they restore Mana instead.

(@MinUnits@) @PercentHealth@% Health or @PercentMana@% Mana

traits.name: Dawnbringer
traits.description:
Dawnbringers rapidly heal some of their maximum Health the first time they drop below @FirstThreshold@%. When this occurs, all allied Dawnbringers gain @BonusDamage@% bonus damage.

(@MinUnits@) @PercentOfMaximumHealth@% of maximum Health

traits.name: Knight
traits.description:
All allies block a flat amount of damage from all sources.

(@MinUnits@) @BlockAmount@ damage blocked

traits.name: Nightbringer
traits.description:
Nightbringers gain a shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds equal to a percent of their maximum Health the first time they drop below @FirstThreshold@%. When this occurs, that Nightbringer gains bonus damage.

(@MinUnits@) @MaxPercentHealthShield@% shield, @BonusDamage@% damage

traits.name: Cavalier
traits.description:
Innate: Cavaliers charge quickly towards their target whenever they move.

Cavaliers take reduced damage. At the start of combat and after each charge, this effect is doubled for @Duration@ seconds.

(@MinUnits@) @DamageReductionPercent@% Damage Reduction

traits.name: Ironclad
traits.description:
All allies gain Armor.

(@MinUnits@) @Armor@ Armor

traits.name: Skirmisher
traits.description:
Skirmishers gain a shield at the start of combat, and bonus Attack Damage each second.

(@MinUnits@) @PercentHealthShield@% max Health shield and +@AttackDamage@ Attack Damage

traits.name: Forgotten
traits.description:
Forgotten champions have bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power. Each Shadow item held by a Forgotten champion increases these bonuses by @ShadowPercent@% on all Forgotten champions, stacking up to @MaxItems@ times.

(@MinUnits@) @InitialADandAP@ Attack Damage and Ability Power

traits.name: Revenant
traits.description:
Revenants revive after their first death each combat. Once revived, they take and deal @DamageAmp@% increased damage.

(@MinUnits@) Revive with @HealthPercent@% Health

traits.name: God-King
traits.description:
(@MinUnits@) God-Kings deal @PercentDamageAmp@% bonus damage to enemies who have at least one of their Rival Traits. This effect is only active when you have exactly 1 unique God-King.

Garen's Rivals: Forgotten, Nightbringer, Coven, Hellion, Dragonslayer, Abomination, Revenant

Darius' Rivals: Redeemed, Dawnbringer, Verdant, Draconic, Ironclad

traits.name: Mystic
traits.description:
All allies gain Magic Resist.

(@MinUnits@) @MagicResist@ Magic Resist

traits.name: Brawler
traits.description:
Brawlers gain additional maximum Health.

(@MinUnits@) +@BonusHealth@ Health

ability.name: Blade of the Dawn
ability.description: Riven empowers her blade, stunning nearby enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds and dealing them @ModifiedMagicDamage@ magic damage. For the next @EmpowerDuration@ seconds, she gains @BonusAttackDamagePercent*100@% bonus Attack Damage.

ability.name: Equinox
ability.description: Soraka calms the area around the enemy with the highest current percent Mana, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to all enemies hit and increasing the cost of their next Ability by @ManaIncrease@%.

ability.name: Deathbringer Strike
ability.description: Aatrox strikes his target, dealing @PercentAttackDamage@% of his Attack Damage (total: @TotalDamage@), and heals himself for @ModifiedHeal@.

ability.name: Force of Will
ability.description: Syndra grabs the nearest enemy and flings them towards the farthest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to all nearby enemies upon impact and stunning the thrown target for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Infinite Duress
ability.description: Warwick leaps to the enemy with the lowest percent Health, stunning them, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage, and healing himself for @HealPercent@% of the damage over @Duration@ seconds. If this Ability kills the target, Warwick will instantly cast it again.

ability.name: Pierce
ability.description: Kalista hurls a spear towards the farthest enemy, dealing @ModifiedPercentAttackDamage@ of her Attack Damage plus @BaseDamage@ bonus physical damage to the first enemy it hits (total: @TotalDamage@). If it kills an enemy, the spear continues and will deal any excess damage to the next enemy it hits.

ability.name: Drunken Rage
ability.description: Gragas drinks from his cask, granting him @DamageReduction@% damage reduction for @Duration@ seconds, and causing his next attack to deal @ModifiedDamage@ bonus magic damage.

ability.name: Subjugate
ability.description: Trundle drains his target's strength, reducing their Health, Armor, Magic Resist, and Attack Damage by @StatStealPercent*100@% and granting himself @ModifiedStatStealMultiplier@ of the drained stats for @Duration@ seconds.

ability.name: Buckler Toss
ability.description: Poppy throws her buckler at the farthest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. The buckler then bounces back, granting Poppy a shield that blocks @ModifiedShield@ damage.

ability.name: Sear
ability.description: Brand launches a ball of fire at the nearest non-seared enemy, searing them for @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Seared enemies have @MRShred@% reduced Magic Resist.

ability.name: Sinister Blade
ability.description:
Katarina throws a dagger at the farthest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. When the dagger lands near the target Katarina teleports to it and immediately launches @NumTargets@ additional daggers at the nearest enemies that each deal @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ magic damage.

Enemies hit have their incoming healing reduced by @HealingReduction@% for @HealingReductionDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Holy Arrows
ability.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows around his target, dealing @PercentOfAD@% of his Attack Damage as physical damage (total: @TooltipDamage@). Varus and allies within the area are blessed, causing them to deal @ModifiedDamage@ bonus magic damage with their attacks on-hit for @Duration@ seconds.

ability.name: Lifeform Disintegration Ray
ability.description: Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy for 3 seconds toward the enemy nearest the center of the battlefield, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ total magic damage over the duration. The beam widens as Vel'Koz channels, and he will pivot if there are no enemies in the area.

ability.name: Infernal Rise
ability.description: Mordekaiser shields himself for @ModifiedShieldPercent@% of his maximum Health for @Duration@ seconds, empowering his mace to deal @ModifiedDamageOnHit@ bonus magic damage and gain 1 hex of range for the same duration.

ability.name: Ethereal Chain
ability.description: LeBlanc launches ethereal chains at the 2 enemies nearest her, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and, after a short delay, stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Spirit of Dread
ability.description: Hecarim creates an aura around himself for @Duration@ seconds. Each enemy within the aura takes @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and heals Hecarim for @ModifiedHealing@ over the duration.

ability.name: Flame Rush
ability.description: Kennen engulfs himself in flame, dashing behind his target, then to the farthest enemy. Enemies he passes through are zapped dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Umbra Blades
ability.description: Passive: Every third attack, Nocturne slashes all adjacent enemies for @PercentAttackDamage@% of his Attack Damage (total: @TotalDamage@), and heals himself for @ModifiedHeal@ of the damage dealt. If only one target is hit, Nocturne also increases his Attack Speed by @AttackSpeed@% for @Duration@ seconds.

ability.name: Cripple
ability.description: Lee Sin slams the ground, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and slowing their Attack Speed by @AttackSpeedSlow@% for @AttackSpeedSlowDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Death Sentence
ability.description: Thresh hooks his farthest enemy with his chain scythe, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and pulling them toward himself for @PullDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Siphon Power
ability.description: Viktor blasts his target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. He also grants a @ModifiedShield@ Health shield to the @NumShields@ allies nearest his target for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Taste their Fear
ability.description: Kha'Zix slashes the nearest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. If the enemy has no adjacent allies, this damage is increased to @ModifiedIsolationDamage@.

ability.name: Silver Bolts
ability.description: Passive: Vayne's third attack on a target deals @ModifiedDamage@ bonus true damage on-hit.

ability.name: Consume
ability.description: Willump bites his target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. If Willump's target has less Health than he does before the bite, it deals an additional @DamageAmp*100@% damage and becomes true damage.

ability.name: Moonfall
ability.description: Diana calls forth moonlight, drawing in all nearby enemies, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Burning Blade
ability.description: Yasuo strikes his target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. He then empowers his blade, gaining @ModifiedTrueDamageBonus@ stacking bonus true damage on-hit for the rest of combat.

ability.name: Whimsy
ability.description: Lulu enchants the @NumTargets@ units nearest to her. Enchanted allies gain @ModifiedAttackSpeedPercent@ bonus Attack Speed for @AllyBuffDuration@ seconds. Enchanted enemies are stunned and transformed into a docile feline for @PolymorphDuration@ seconds, taking @DamageAmp@% increased damage. If there are less than 3 units nearby, Lulu will enchant herself.

ability.name: Transfusion
ability.description: Vladimir deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to the target and heals for @ModifiedHeal@ Health.

ability.name: Upgrade!!!
ability.description:
Heimerdinger empowers his Baby Dragon's next attack. The Baby Dragon's overcharged attack launches 3 fireballs across the battlefield, dealing @ModifiedTurretMagicDamage@ magic damage and burning enemies for @BurnPercent@% of their maximum Health as true damage over @BurnDuration@ seconds, reducing healing by 50% for the duration.

If Heimerdinger does not have a Baby Dragon, this Ability will create one instead.

ability.name: Violent Tendencies
ability.description:
Passive: Kled deals @PercentOfAttackDamage@% of his Attack Damage (total: @TotalDamage@) every 4th attack.

Kled enters combat on Skaarl, granting himself a shield for @ModifiedShieldPercent@ of his maximum Health. When the shield is broken Kled dismounts, becoming untargetable briefly, gaining @AttackSpeedPercent@% Attack Speed.

ability.name: Prismatic Illumination
ability.description: Lux launches her wand toward her farthest ally, then calls the wand back to her hand. The wand shields each ally in its path by @ModifiedShieldAmount@ for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Lux also empowers her next attack to deal an additional @ModifiedHitDamage@ magic damage.

ability.name: Solar Barrier
ability.description: Leona creates a barrier around herself, reducing all incoming damage by @ModifiedDamageReduction@ for 4 seconds.

ability.name: Nature's Touch
ability.description: All allies in a large area around Taric are healed for @ModifiedHealth@ Health and gain @Armor@ Armor for 5 seconds.

ability.name: Empowered Strike
ability.description: Jax slams his target for @PercentAttackDamage@% of his Attack Damage (total: @TotalDamage@) and gains @ModifiedAS@ stacking Attack Speed for the remainder of combat. Jax leaps to the nearest enemy if no target is in his Attack Range.

ability.name: Soulflare
ability.description:
Karma fires a burst of energy towards a random enemy's location that detonates upon impact, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to adjacent enemies, and reducing Karma's maximum Mana by @MaxManaReduction@ (down to a minimum of 10).

Karma empowers every third cast, causing it to launch 3 bursts of energy toward different targets instead of 1.

ability.name: Dark Vigil
ability.description: Aphelios launches @NumOfAttacks@ attacks simultaneously, one at his target and the rest at the enemies nearest to them, dealing @PercentAttackDamage*100@% of his Attack Damage plus @ModifiedBaseDamage@ physical damage to each. (Total: @TotalDamage@ %i:scaleAD%)

ability.name: Enchanted Arrow
ability.description: Ashe fires an arrow at the farthest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy hit and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds. If the arrow travels at least @HexThreshold@ hexes, the stun duration is doubled. Enemies within 1 hex receive @ReducedEffectiveness*100@% of these effects.

ability.name: Rune Prison
ability.description: Ryze imprisons the nearest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds. His next cast spreads from his target, applying the same damage and half the stun to all enemies in a large area around that target.

ability.name: Daisy!
ability.description:
Ivern summons his Sentinel friend Daisy to fight with him. Daisy receives @DaisyBonusAPConversion@% of Ivern's Ability Power and immediately casts Shockwave upon arrival.

If Daisy is already in battle, Ivern increases her Ability Power by @ModifiedAbilityPowerBonus@ and commands her to cast Shockwave again.

ability.name: Aegis Assault
ability.description:
Pantheon braces his shield, reducing all incoming damage by @ModifiedDamageReductionPercent@ for @Duration@ seconds, and dealing @PercentAttackDamage@% of his Attack Damage (total: @TotalDamage@) in the area in front of him over the duration.

Enemies hit have their incoming healing reduced by @HealingReduction@% for @HealingReductionDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Doombringer
ability.description: Volibear leaps toward his target, then slams the ground in a large area around him. This effect knocks up and stuns enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds, removing any shields and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage.

ability.name: Teemo's Cruelty
ability.description: Teemo scatters @MushroomCount@ Infernal Souls around a random enemy. When an enemy nears an Infernal Soul (or after @DetonationDelay@ seconds), it explodes dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and reducing their Attack Speed by @AttackSpeedSlowTooltip@%.

ability.name: God-Wolf's Carnage
ability.description: Darius transforms into a God-Wolf, becoming unstoppable as he lunges towards a nearby enemy. @WolfCount@ God-Wolves join him in his hunt, each targeting their own prey. When God-Wolves bite enemies, they deal @PercentAttackDamage@% of Darius' Attack Damage (total: @ModifiedDamage@) as physical damage, and reduce the enemy's Armor by @ArmorReductionTooltip@% for @DebuffDuration@ seconds. When Darius bites his prey, his next @NumAttacks@ attacks restore @ModifiedHealing@ of his maximum Health.

ability.name: God-Lion's Justice
ability.description:
Garen calls down a sword that strikes a large area around his target, dealing @ModifiedPercentMaxHealth@ of each target's max Health in magic damage and reducing their Magic Resist by @MRShredTooltip@% for @MRShredDuration@ seconds.

Garen gains a shield equal to @ModifiedShieldPercent@ of his maximum Health for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Grasping Roots
ability.description: Zyra sends a surge of vines toward her farthest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and stunning all enemies they hit for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Feral Instinct
ability.description:
Udyr swaps between Turtle and Tiger stance with each cast, gaining the following benefits:
Turtle: Gain a @ModifiedShieldAmount@ Health shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
Tiger: Strike 3 times quickly with his next attack for @PercentAD@% of his Attack Damage (total: @ModifiedPercentAD@).

ability.name: Divine Ascent
ability.description:
Passive: Kayle ascends every @AscensionDelay@ seconds. Each bonus stacks with the one before, until she is fully ascended.
1st: Attacks deal @PercentAttackDamage@% of Kayle's Attack Damage as bonus true damage. (total: @TotalAttackDamage@)
2nd: Attacks explode around the target dealing her Attack Damage and bonus true damage to adjacent enemies.
3rd: Every @NumAttacksImmunity@th attack grants Kayle immunity to damage for @ImmunityDuration@ second.
4th: Attacks cause swords to rain down around the target, dealing @TotalAoEDamage@ magic damage.

ability.name: Sovereign's Domination
ability.description:
Viego corrupts the soul of his target for @Duration@ seconds, stunning them and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage, increasing @IncreasePercent@% each second. Viego will be interrupted if he is stunned, and Viego's allies prefer not to target his victim during soul corruption.

If his victim dies, they are resurrected at full Health to fight for him, but they lose @DecayPercentDamagePerSecond@% of their maximum Health per second. Resurrected enemies receive the Trait bonuses of Viego's team instead of their own.

ability.name: Spinning Axes
ability.description:
Draven starts spinning an axe, empowering his next attack to deal @ADMult*100@% of his Attack Damage plus @ModifiedDamage@ bonus physical damage. (Total: @TotalDamage@ %i:scaleAD%) It will return to his original location after striking the target. If Draven catches it, he will empower the axe again.

Draven can spin up to 2 axes at a time.

ability.name: Anchor Slam
ability.description: Nautilus causes the ground beneath his target to erupt, knocking them up, stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds, and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. Enemies adjacent to the target receive 50% of this effect.

ability.name: Wolf's Frenzy
ability.description: Wolf returns to Lamb, healing them both for @ModifiedHeal@ health and then launches himself at the lowest health enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage.

ability.name: 1000 Daggers
ability.description: Lissandra hurls a dagger toward the enemy with the highest Attack Damage, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to the first target it hits. After hitting its initial target or at its final destination, the dagger explodes dealing @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ magic damage to nearby targets. All enemies hit have their Attack Damage reduced by @ADReduction@% for @ADReductionDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Aspect of the Cougar
ability.description:
Nidalee transforms into a cougar and leaps behind the lowest Health enemy.

While in cougar form, Nidalee gains @DodgeChance@% Dodge Chance, @AttackSpeedPercent@% Attack Speed, and her attacks become melee attacks that deal @ModifiedDamage@ bonus magic damage every 4th attack.

ability.name: Soul Shackles
ability.description: Morgana fires chains to nearby enemies, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. After @ChainDuration@ seconds, all chained enemies are dealt an additional @ModifiedEndDamage@ magic damage and stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Lamb's Respite
ability.description: Lamb creates a zone around herself for @Duration@ seconds that prevents allies within from falling below @ModifiedMinHealth@ Health or dying. While Lamb's Respite is active, Wolf is invulnerable.

ability.name: Attract and Repel
ability.description: Rell leaps into the air and creates a tether between herself and her farthest ally. When she lands, the tether breaks, stunning all nearby enemies in its path for @StunDuration@ seconds. This effect also grants a @ModifiedShieldAmount@ Health shield for @ShieldDuration@ to nearby allies in the same area.

ability.name: Fury of the North
ability.description: Sejuani signals Bristle to charge, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and stunning her target for @StunDuration@ seconds. She then gains Frost Armor, granting her @DefensiveStats@ Armor and Magic Resist for @Duration@ seconds.

ability.name: Arcane Bomb
ability.description: Ziggs throws an arcane bomb at his target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage.

ability.name: Haymaker
ability.description: After a brief wind up Sett punches forward in a cone, shredding @ModifiedArmorShred@ flat Armor for @ArmorShredDuration@ seconds (stacks) and dealing @PhysicalDamagePercent@% of his Attack Damage as physical damage to all enemies in the area. (total: <scaleAD>@TotalDamage@ %i:scaleAD%</scaleAD>)

items.name: Bàn Tay Phục Hận
items.description:
At the beginning of combat, the holder gains both of the following:
  • +@BonusAD@ Attack Damage and +@BonusSP@ Ability Power.
  • Attacks and Abilities heal for @TraitMultiplier@% of damage dealt.

    • These bonuses expire after each takedown, and renew on the next.

items.name: Vuốt Ác Long
items.description: Reduces incoming magic damage by <TFTShadowItemPenalty>@MagicReduction@%</TFTShadowItemPenalty>. <TFTShadowItemBonus>Negates bonus damage from incoming critical hits.</TFTShadowItemBonus>

items.name: Dây Chuyền Tội Lỗi
items.description: The holder radiates an aura to <TFTShadowItemBonus>all allies on the board</TFTShadowItemBonus> except themself, and heals them for <TFTShadowItemPenalty>@MissingHealthHeal@%</TFTShadowItemPenalty> of their missing Health every @HealTickRate@ seconds. <TFTShadowItemPenalty>Each time this happens, the holder damages themself for @SelfDamagePercent@% of their current Health as true damage. </TFTShadowItemPenalty>

items.name: Hắc Quỷ Thư Morello
items.description:
When the holder deals magic or true damage with their Ability, they burn the target, dealing @BurnPercent@% of the target's maximum Health as true damage over @BurnDuration@ seconds, and reducing healing by @GrievousWoundsPercent@% for the duration of the burn.
The holder's Ability deals @DamageReductionPercent@% less damage.

[Unique - Only One Per Champion]

items.name: Kiếm Hắc Ám
items.description: %i:scaleAD% +@AD@ Attack Damage

items.name: Áo Choàng Thiên Thực
items.description:
Every @ICD@ second(s), a random enemy within @HexRange@ hexes is burned for @BurnPercent@% of their maximum Health as true damage over @BurnDuration@ seconds. Any healing they receive is reduced by @GrievousWoundsPercent@%. The holder is also burned for @SelfBurnPercent@% of their maximum Health as true damage over @SelfBurnDuration@ seconds, and any healing they receive is reduced by @GrievousWoundsPercent@%.

[Unique - Only One Per Champion]

items.name: Kiếm Súng Chợ Đen
items.description: The holder's magic and true damage from Abilities heals the ally with lowest percent Health for <TFTShadowItemBonus>@OmniVamp@% of the damage dealt.</TFTShadowItemBonus> <TFTShadowItemPenalty>This heal cannot affect the holder.</TFTShadowItemPenalty>

items.name: Hắc Cực Kiếm
items.description:
Grants @CritChance@% Critical Strike Chance (including components). Each point of Critical Strike Chance above 100% becomes +@BonusCritDmgPerCritAbove100@% Critical Strike Damage. The holder also gains @BonusCritDamage@% Critical Strike Damage. Each time the holder attacks or casts their Ability, they take true damage equal to @PercentMaxHPTrueDamage@% of their max Health.

[Unique - Only One Per Champion]

items.name: Bùa Xanh Đen Đậm
items.description:
After casting their Ability, the holder gains %i:scaleMana% @PostCastMana@ Mana. If the holder has less than @HealthThreshold@% Health, this is increased to %i:scaleMana% @EmpoweredPostCastMana@.

[Unique - Only One Per Champion]

items.name: Chén Tà Thuật
items.description: When combat begins, all of the holder's allies within @HexRange@ hex in the same row gain %i:scaleAP% <TFTShadowItemBonus>@BonusAP@ Ability Power</TFTShadowItemBonus> for the rest of combat. <TFTShadowItemPenalty>The holder loses %i:scaleAP% @APLost@ Ability Power instead of gaining any.</TFTShadowItemPenalty>

items.name: Xẻng Hắc Ám
items.description: It must do something evil...

items.name: Diệt Khồng Lồ Tà Ác
items.description: The holder's Abilities and attacks do @LargeIncreasePct@% bonus damage if the target has more than @HealthThreshold@ maximum Health.

items.name: Áo Choàng Hắc Ám Tĩnh Lặng
items.description:
When combat begins, the holder shoots a beam straight ahead and behind that delays affected enemies' and other allies' first ability cast, increasing their maximum Mana by @CostIncrease@% until they cast.

[Unique - Only One Per Champion]

items.name: Găng Hắc Ám
items.description:
+@CritChance@ Critical Strike Chance
+@DodgeChance@ Dodge Chance

items.name: Vuốt Ma Ám
items.description:
When combat begins, the holder and all allies within @HexRange@ hex(es) in the same row gain a shield that blocks the first enemy Ability.

[Unique - Only One Per Champion]

items.name: Nỏ Sét Bóng Tối
items.description: Enemies <TFTShadowItemPenalty>and allies (except the holder)</TFTShadowItemPenalty> within @HexRange@ hexes are zapped when they cast an Ability, taking magic damage scaling with their max Mana. Enemies take @EnemyManaRatio@% of their max Mana, and allies take @AllyManaRatio@% of their max Mana. <TFTShadowItemBonus>Whenever an ally or enemy is zapped, the holder gains %i:scaleAP% @APGain@ Ability Power for the rest of combat.</TFTShadowItemBonus>

items.name: Giáp Tử Chiến Warmog
items.description: Grants %i:scaleHealth% <TFTShadowItemBonus>@TooltipDisplayHealth@ bonus Health</TFTShadowItemBonus> (including components). <TFTShadowItemPenalty>The holder takes @HealthLoss@ true damage each second.</TFTShadowItemPenalty>

items.name: Huyết Cuồng Đao Guinsoo
items.description: Attacks grant <TFTShadowItemBonus>+@AttackSpeedPerStack@%</TFTShadowItemBonus> bonus Attack Speed for the rest of combat. The bonus Attack Speed can stack any number of times. <TFTShadowItemPenalty>The holder is dealt @PercentSelfDamage@% of their maximum Health as true damage each attack.</TFTShadowItemPenalty>

items.description:
Increases the holder's Attack Range by @HexRangeIncrease@ hex. Additionally, the holder gains %i:scaleAS% +@BonusAS@% bonus Attack Speed when there are no enemies within @HexRequirement@ hex(es).

The holder's attacks can no longer miss.

items.name: Găng Lừa Lọc
items.description:
At the beginning of each planning phase, the holder equips 2 temporary items. These are always full shadow items.

items.name: Khăn Kháng Thuật Tà Ác

The holder gains immunity to crowd control for the entirety of combat and receives %i:scaleHealth% -@ShadowHealthPenaltyPercent@% maximum Health.

[Unique - Only One Per Champion]

items.name: Dây Chuyền Silver Lunari
items.description: When combat begins, the holder and all allies within @HexRange@ hexes in the same row gain <TFTShadowItemBonus>@BonusDefenses@ bonus Armor and Magic Resist</TFTShadowItemBonus>, but gain <TFTShadowItemPenalty>@PlayerFacingMPAReduction@ less Mana per attack.</TFTShadowItemPenalty>

items.name: Hắc Phong Kiếm
items.description:
When combat begins, the holder summons a whirlwind on the opposite side of the arena that removes the closest enemy from combat for @BanishDuration@ seconds. Once the enemy returns to combat, they gain @EnemyBonusStats@ Attack Damage and Ability Power for the rest of combat. Ignores CC immunity.

[Unique - Only One Per Champion]

items.name: Ác Thương Shojin
items.description: The holder's attacks restore %i:scaleMana% <TFTShadowItemBonus>@FlatManaRestore@ additional Mana.</TFTShadowItemBonus> <TFTShadowItemPenalty>The holder deals @DamageAmpPenalty@% less damage.</TFTShadowItemPenalty>

items.name: Quyền Năng Phục Hận
items.description: @PercentDamage@% of incoming damage is stored. Every @SecondsBetweenProcs@ seconds, the holder's next attack unleashes this stored damage as true damage.

items.name: Thông Đạo Cảm Tử Zz'Rot
items.description:
At the start of combat, the holder taunts enemies within @HexRadius@ hexes.

When the holder dies, an Unstable Voidspawn with @ZombieHealth@ Health arises and taunts enemies again. When it dies it deals @ExplosionDamage@ true damage to enemies within @ExplosionHexRange@ hex(es).

Voidspawns that arise from summoned units are @SummonedStatReduction@% effective.

items.description: Physical damage heals the holder for @Lifesteal@% of the damage dealt. <TFTShadowItemBonus>Each time the holder heals to @HealthThresholdPercent@% Health, they gain @BonusAS@% Attack Speed for @BonusASDuration@ seconds.</TFTShadowItemBonus> <TFTShadowItemPenalty>The holder takes @HealthLossPercent@% of their maximum Health in true damage at the beginning of combat or upon being equipped.</TFTShadowItemPenalty>
